items.title: Inside OpenAI’s in-house data agent
items.title_zh: 走进 OpenAI 内部数据智能体
items.summary: OpenAI describes how it built an in-house AI data agent that uses GPT-5, Codex and memory to reason over large datasets and deliver insights in minutes.

items.title: JAF: Judge Agent Forest
items.summary: JAF is a framework in which a judge agent performs joint inference across a cohort of query-response pairs from a primary agent, rather than evaluating responses in isolation, so cross-instance patterns can feed back into improvement. It can be instantiated through in-context learning and uses a learned locality-sensitive hashing scheme to select diverse exemplars, validated on cloud misconfiguration triage.

items.title: RedSage: A Cybersecurity Generalist LLM
items.summary: RedSage is an open-source, locally deployable cybersecurity assistant trained on 11.8B tokens of domain-focused continual-pretraining data and 266K multi-turn samples generated by an agentic augmentation pipeline. At the 8B scale it reportedly beats baselines by up to 5.59 points on cybersecurity benchmarks and 5.05 points on Open LLM Leaderboard tasks, and the authors release models, data and code along with a new RedSage-Bench.

items.title: Joint Continual Learning of Local Language Models and Cloud Offloading Decisions with Budget Constraints
items.title_zh: 本地语言模型与云端卸载决策的联合持续学习（带预算约束）
items.summary: The paper proposes DA-GRPO, a dual-advantage extension of Group Relative Policy Optimization that puts cloud-usage constraints into advantage computation so a local small model can learn task competence and collaboration behavior together. Experiments on math reasoning and code generation reportedly improve post-switch accuracy, reduce forgetting and keep cloud usage stable versus prior collaborative and routing approaches.

items.title: Why Are AI Agent Involved Pull Requests (Fix-Related) Remain Unmerged? An Empirical Study
items.title_zh: AI 智能体参与的修复类拉取请求为何仍未合并？一项实证研究
items.summary: The study analyzes 8,106 fix-related pull requests authored by five AI coding agents from the AIDEV POP dataset, then manually reviews a sample of 326 closed-but-unmerged PRs to build a catalog of 12 failure reasons. Test-case failures and prior resolution of the same issue by other PRs were the most common causes of non-integration, while build or deployment failures were comparatively rare.

items.title: SCALAR: Quantifying Structural Hallucination, Consistency, and Reasoning Gaps in Materials Foundation Models
items.title_zh: SCALAR：量化材料基础模型中的结构幻觉、一致性与推理差距
items.summary: SCALAR is a benchmark for geometric scale generalization in materials foundation models, using about 100,000 DFT-validated structures from a few atoms to over 18,000 atoms across property prediction, chain-of-thought and inverse retrieval tasks. Experiments reportedly show large model-dependent shifts under explicit reasoning, often reducing hallucination and error but frequently destabilizing consistency or validity.

items.title: Purely Agent-Driven Black-Box Optimization for Biological Design
items.title_zh: 纯 Agent 驱动的生物设计黑箱优化
items.summary: The authors present PABLO, a hierarchical agentic system that uses scientific LLMs to generate and iteratively refine biological candidates. It reports state-of-the-art results on GuacaMol molecular design and antimicrobial peptide optimization, and follow-up in vitro tests showed activity against drug-resistant pathogens.

items.title: Specialists or Generalists? Multi-Agent and Single-Agent LLMs for Essay Grading
items.title_zh: 专家还是通才？用于作文评分的多智能体与单智能体 LLM
items.summary: Using the ASAP 2.0 corpus and GPT-5.1, the authors find that a multi-agent grading system was significantly better at identifying weak essays while a single-agent system performed better on mid-range essays. Providing two examples per score level raised QWK by about 26% for both architectures.

items.title: didilili/ai-agents-from-zero
items.title_zh: didilili/ai-agents-from-zero：2026 年系统化 AI Agent 速成指南
items.summary: A Chinese-language Python repository billed as a systematic 2026 AI agent course, covering LangChain, LangGraph, Coze, Dify, MCP, RAG, prompting, enterprise deployment and interview preparation.

items.title: yilewang/llm-for-zotero
items.title_zh: yilewang/llm-for-zotero：为 Zotero 文献库打造的开源研究 Agent
items.summary: An open-source TypeScript research agent system designed for use with a Zotero library.

items.title: Moltworker: a self-hosted personal AI agent, minus the minis
items.title_zh: Moltworker：自托管的个人 AI Agent，无需额外硬件
items.summary: Moltworker is a middleware Worker plus adapted scripts that let users run Moltbot (formerly Clawdbot) on Cloudflare's Sandbox SDK and Developer Platform APIs, enabling a self-hosted AI personal assistant without new hardware.
